objective: Decide whether the latest plan's optional no-source GGML_MOE_KEEP_TOPK_LAYER_VALUE=2 strict France probe is justified.

implementation_audit.mechanism: For selected expert rows with id >= keep_topk, the code zero-fills the destination slice and does not enqueue the row for CPU fallback or CUDA one-stream handling.
implementation_audit.correctness_risk: Changing keep_topk changes routed expert contribution and can change generation trajectory, answer length, and semantic correctness.

historical_evidence.diagnosis: Output ended incomplete and gate/cache counters changed materially.
Even the smallest early-layer pruning changed output trajectory and increased misses/refault pressure.

historical_evidence.candidate: layer 30-39 top2 with temporary second range
historical_evidence.diagnosis: Late-layer top2 changed cache trajectory, increased misses/refaults, and failed manual France correctness.
Remaining CPU fallback already matches unpruned rows. Additional row removal is approximate top-k pruning; relevant top2 variants already failed trajectory/correctness/performance.

candidate_under_audit.relative_to_sota: Prunes one more routed up/down expert for every layer 10-39 compared with accepted SOTA.
candidate_under_audit.risk_vs_prior_failures: This is more aggressive than the already failed layer 30-39 top2 probe and affects three times as many late/mid layers.
candidate_under_audit.bounded_speed_reason: It could only save part of remaining up/down fallback by removing model work. It does not solve source/page stalls, exact compute throughput, or prompt-general correctness.

decision.reason: The plan allowed value=2 only if the audit supported a cheap bounded probe. Current implementation and historical evidence show it is approximate model pruning with repeated correctness and performance failures. Running 10-39=>2 would be a blind, more aggressive repeat, not a correctness-preserving optimization.
decision.next_direction: Close no-source top-k pruning and return to exact up/down fallback elimination or a disk-enabled full 4Expert/alternate artifact route.

push_policy: This closure artifact and plan update must be committed and pushed to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb. Any future accepted SOTA still requires full reproduction metadata and immediate push before promotion.
